reason: Conversation 1 went straight to the sensible first step (unplug, wash the pre-motor/HEPA filters, dry 24h, check hose/wand), correctly identified the never-washed filters as the cause, gave sound drying and maintenance advice, and resolved the fault with no part needed. Conversation 2 never asked about the filters at all, repeated the brush-bar check despite the customer already answering it, misread 'bit of fluff' as 'you found a blockage', and then escalated to a repairer citing 'an internal seal or the motor area' - an unsupported conclusion that would likely have cost the homeowner a call-out or a new vacuum for a simple filter wash.
